name: Near flight with the ground G40: range gates inside 5 mi
notes: Short flight, no further than 5 statute miles from the ground radio site. Range gates at 1, 2, 3, 4 mi from the site, each a band across the flight box 400 m deep, keying its range message for 15 s when the aircraft enters it, going out and coming back. The outer band, from 4.5 to 5 mi, keys its message while the aircraft is in it (max 120 s a visit). TX attenuation 10 dB on TRx2B. Location triggers on and the aircraft feed listening before the aircraft moves. G40-AX35 receives on TRx1A from 5 s after Run mission for 60 min and decodes every range message.

authorization.note: bench: HPA output on the coupler and load, no antenna, unless the card says otherwise
